description: Source code for the Infineon DPS310 temperature and pressure sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, measurement, calibration, and configuration functions.

methods.name: dps310_calib_coeff_creation
methods.description: Converts raw calibration bytes into calibration coefficients structure.

methods.name: poll_rdy
methods.description: Polls a register until specific bits are set, indicating data is ready.

methods.name: dps310_trigger_temperature
methods.description: Triggers a temperature measurement and waits for completion.

methods.name: dps310_trigger_pressure
methods.description: Triggers a pressure measurement and waits for completion.

methods.name: dps310_hw_bug_fix
methods.description: Applies a hardware bug fix sequence via I2C writes.

methods.name: dps310_scale_temperature
methods.description: Scales and compensates raw temperature data to micro degrees Celsius.

methods.name: dps310_scale_pressure
methods.description: Scales and compensates raw pressure data to kilopascals.

methods.name: raw_to_int24
methods.description: Converts raw 3-byte data to signed 24-bit integer.

methods.name: dps310_measure_tmp_psr
methods.description: Performs measurement of temperature and pressure, updates data structure.

methods.name: dps310_measure_psr
methods.description: Performs pressure measurement, updates data structure.

methods.name: dps310_measure_tmp
methods.description: Performs temperature measurement, updates data structure.

methods.name: dps310_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor, loads calibration, and configures measurement parameters.

methods.name: dps310_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches a new sample of data based on specified sensor channel.

methods.name: dps310_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves the latest measurement data for a specified sensor channel.
